newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wheelock raises loan to HK$5.0 bln.
newsitem.headline: Wheelock raises loan to HK$5.0 bln.

text.p: Wheelock and Co has increased its revolving credit/term loan facility for a second time after the issue was oversubscribed in general syndication, arranger Citicorp International said.
The loan was raised to HK$5.0 billion from HK$4.5 billion. The transaction already had been increased from HK$3.0 billion in the sub-undewriting phase.

Twenty six institutions in addition to the four arrangers joined the deal. Arrangers are Banque Nationale de Paris, Citicorp International, J.P. Morgan Securities and NatWest Markets. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843-6371
